summary: Practise adapting project decisions with Cynefin, stakeholder mapping and decision reviews. Explore the five-day course and its applied curriculum.
lede: Adaptive leadership in projects helps project managers, project leads and delivery specialists respond when assumptions, priorities or stakeholder support shift. The course develops skills to distinguish routine issues from adaptive challenges, assess uncertainty with Cynefin and the Stacey Matrix, and map stakeholder influence. Through project scenarios, participants practise testing responses, reviewing decision evidence and capturing lessons to explain adjustments to teams and sponsors.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for people who make or support decisions when project assumptions, stakeholder responses or delivery conditions change. It suits professionals with project experience who need a clearer method for mobilizing teams and documenting adaptive choices.
prerequisites: Prior experience working on or supporting projects is expected. Familiarity with project plans, stakeholders, risks and change decisions will help you apply the exercises. Coding or programming is not required.
